ESTA Backs Use of Intelligent Access to Help European Transport Sector

📅 2026-07-21 ✍️ Joshua Allen, Heavy Lift & Project Forwarding International 🏷️ ESTA, Intelligent Access, European transport, abnormal road transport, TomTom, TISA, DG Move, POLIS, heavy haulage, map data
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

The European association of abnormal road transport and mobile cranes (ESTA) has endorsed the use of Intelligent Access systems in the European transport sector, joined by representatives from TomTom/TISA, the Dutch ministry of infrastructure, the European Commission's DG Move, and POLIS to push for regulatory reforms and investment.

📌 Key takeaways

  • ESTA has formally backed Intelligent Access for the European abnormal road transport and mobile crane sector
  • The initiative was presented alongside representatives from the Dutch ministry of infrastructure, DG Move at the European Commission, TomTom/TISA, and POLIS
  • Intelligent Access aims to improve routing and compliance for oversized and overweight vehicles through digital map and traffic data integration
  • ESTA hopes the endorsement will apply further pressure on regulators and politicians to back reforms and investment
  • The collaboration spans industry associations, national governments, EU institutions, and mapping/traffic data providers
